versions.content: Various Formula Representation The formula itself takes at least one of the following forms: • a graphic ( LGraphic ), which contains the formula represented as a graphic. • a math captured in T E Xmath mode ( texMath ) • a generic math ( genericMath ) • a verbatim ( verbatim ) when the formula is written as simple text, where the spaces are preserved These forms may exist simultaneously. When a documentation is rendered, the ren- dering engine should use the representation with best fit to the rendition format.
